0.reason: origin/HEAD, set by every ordinary clone, names the primary branch whatever it is called; only a clone with no remote HEAD and a primary other than main or master falls through, which reads as uncomparable and composes a full review, the safe direction

findings.text: non-blocking: _integration_ref falls back only to origin/HEAD, origin/main and origin/master, so a clone without a remote HEAD whose primary branch is neither (a develop-based project) answers empty and every delta reads as uncomparable; the review is then composed fresh over the whole dispatch-base range, which is the oversized-review defect this node exists to remove. Origin/HEAD covers an ordinary clone, so the exposure is narrow and the plan states the missing-ref reading explicitly.
